name: fishstack
description: A fishStack pane for Claude Code: a perm worktree with a read-only head start, crew dials and a context library.

autoWorktree.title: Perm worktree
autoWorktree.description: Default for the Perm worktree toggle: give each session started in a main checkout, and each worktree Claude Code creates, a lasting slot, read-only until it is ready. Off leaves worktrees to Claude Code.

worktreeRoot.title: Worktree root
worktreeRoot.description: Where worktree slots are kept. Empty keeps them in the repository's .claude/worktrees/fishstack/, where Claude Code enters them without asking.

setupCommand.title: Setup command
setupCommand.description: A shell command run in a new slot before the session moves in (say `pnpm install`). Empty runs nothing.

minFreeGb.title: Free disk to keep (GB)
minFreeGb.description: Perm worktree stops warming new slots when less than this much disk is free, as CommissionAI does at 20 GB.

autoAnswerMinutes.title: Autopilot answers after (minutes)
autoAnswerMinutes.description: With the Autonomy dial on Autopilot, a question the agent asked that nobody answers in this many minutes is answered with its recommended option (or the first).
